key_architectural_points: 1. MULTI-DOMAIN ROUTING & PREVIEW: The public portal inspects the current window.location.hostname OR query param ?site=slug (e.g. ?site=tuna40 or ?site=deniz23). It dynamically fetches the configuration, ad slots, and theme for that active domain.

2. BACKOFFICE DOMAIN & AD MANAGEMENT: A single centralized admin backoffice (/admin) manages unlimited domains. For each domain: configure title, logo, header text, marquee news, primary/accent colors, custom CSS, layout column count (1-6), enable/disable welcome pop-up modal, and pop-up content (title, promo image, countdown, CTA button, redirect URL).

3. AD SLOT TYPES & FULL CUSTOMIZATION: Supports (a) Image Banner + Link with custom badge/ribbon (b) Raw HTML / Embed iframe code (c) Rich CTA Text Card with glowing buttons. Each ad slot has: title, category tag, column span (1 to full), row order, status (active/inactive), click tracking counter, and target URL.

4. TUNA40 & DENIZ23 VISUAL BLEND: tuna40 high-impact dark betting portal layout with top jackpot banner, dynamic grid slots, sponsor badges, combined with deniz23 high-converting animated welcome pop-up modal on entry with countdown timer and VIP claim CTA.

5. CLOUDFLARE & SERVER INTEGRATION GUIDE: Provide a dedicated Backoffice page with interactive DNS setup instructions, CNAME/A-Record generator, Cloudflare SSL/Proxy settings, and Nginx/Custom Domain routing checklist for connecting new domains seamlessly.

6. DATA PERSISTENCE & SEED DATA: Pre-seed MongoDB with sample sites ('tuna40-portal', 'deniz23-bet', 'vip-bonus-merkezi') and 10+ realistic ad slots with high-contrast visuals, responsive preview toggle, and instant live preview iframe/switcher.

7. TURKISH LANGUAGE UI: Public portal and Admin backoffice must be in clear, high-fidelity Turkish with terms like 'Domain Yönetimi', 'Reklam Alanları', 'Karşılama Pop-up', 'Canlı Önizleme', 'Tıklama İstatistikleri'.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use high visual contrast, electric amber (#F59E0B) and cyan (#06B6D4) against deep obsidian (#090B10).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.glass_and_borders: Use 1px crisp borders (#1E293B) and subtle glass panels (bg-[#121620]/90 backdrop-blur-md) with ambient neon glows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_ids: Ensure every critical element has data-testid (e.g. data-testid='site-switch-select', data-testid='popup-modal-cta', data-testid='admin-save-site-btn', data-testid='ad-card-item').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner for success/error feedback on domain additions, ad slot updates, and theme changes.
